title: Democrats seize US congress, hand Trump major loss | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: US midterm elections, Martin Romualdez, Alex Eala

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Democrats seize Congress in sweeping midterm repudiation of Trump

blocks.text: Democrats seize control of both the Senate and House, scoring sweeping victories in Republican strongholds for the first time in generations.

items: Supreme Court junks Romualdez challenge vs Ombudsman plunder case

blocks.text: The Supreme Court allows the Office of the Ombudsman to continue its investigation into the plunder case of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

items: Philippines tries to ease tensions with China as ASEAN Summit nears

blocks.text: The Philippines and China engage in diplomatic talks to ease tensions ahead of the 49th ASEAN Summit.

items: What’s with Marcos’ new EO on class suspensions?

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signs an executive order allowing school heads to suspend and resume classes.

items: World No. 17 Alex Eala downs Emerson Jones to start Hong Kong Open bid

blocks.text: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala starts her Hong Kong Open bid on a high, after defeating Australia’s Emerson Jones, 6 to 4, 6 to 3, on Tuesday, November 3. – Rappler.com
